prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-19, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-02-19):
| Current ratio           | 2.29 |
| Retained earnings       | 3,431M |
| Current liabilities     | 5,712M |
| Current assets          | 13,066M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 33,867M |
| Total liabilities       | 23,079M |
| Total assets            | 57,121M |
| EBIT / operating income | 3,688M |
| Revenue                 | 6,571M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company displays solid liquidity with a current ratio of 2.29, a strong equity cushion (shareholders’ equity > long-term and current liabilities combined), and very healthy operating profitability (EBIT margin ≈ 56% on revenue). Leverage is moderate, with debt well covered by earnings and a sizable equity base, supporting a robust credit profile, though there is no detailed cash flow or interest expense data to push into the highest rated bands.

DECISION: AA-
